paite: Huchi in Khrist toh kaihthohkhawm a na om tak man un, tunglam a Pathian taklam a tu Khrist omna a thil omte zong un.
heading: Gingtute Dinmun Leh Omdan
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

paite: Tunglam a thil omte ah na lungsim uh nga un; lei a thil omte a nga lou in.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

paite: Na sita ua, tu in na hinna uh Pathian ah Khrist toh sel in a-om hi.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

paite: Khrist i hinna uh ahong kilak chiang in nou leng amah kiang ah thupi in na kilak sam ding uhi.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

paite: Huchi in noumau a lei lam thil deihna omte that un, kingaihna, nitna, hukna, utna gilou, huaihamna; huai milim biakna ahi.
heading: That Un
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

paite: Huai thilte ziak in Pathian thangpaihna thumang lou tate tung ah atung nak ahi.
english: for which things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

paite: Nou leng tuma lam a huai thilte a na khosak lai un, huaite ah na kalsuan uhi.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

paite: Himahleh tu in nou leng hiai tengteng, hehna, thangpaihna, huatna, gensiatna, na kam ua pau zahmohte koihmang un.
heading: Koihmang Un
english: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

paite: Mihing lui athilhih toh na suahkheta uh chih mu in, kuamah kizuausantuah kei un,
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

paite: mihing thak in na kivanta ngal ua; huai mihing thak asiampa batpih bang a theihna a siam thak in a-om lellel hi.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

paite: Huai ah Grik mi leh Juda mi, zeksum leh sum louh, melmak mite, Skithia mite, sikhate, noplente leng a-om kei; Khrist bangkim hi zaw in, bangkim ah a-om behlap lai hi.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

paite: Huaiziak in Pathian mitel, misiangthou leh deihtakte bang in lainatna lungtang, migitna, kingaih-niamna, thunuailutna, thuakzohna in kivan un.
heading: Kivan Un
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

paite: Kuapeuh in kua tung ah leng thubuai nei hi le uchin, kithuakzou chiat in, kingaidamtuah unla, Toupa'n ahon ngaihdam tak bang in kingaidamtuah chiat un.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

paite: Huan huai tengteng tung ah itna silhthuah un; huai in thil bangkim kituaktak in agakkhawm hi.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

paite: Huan Khrist khamuanna in na lungtang uah vai hawm hen, huai ding in pumpi khat a sap na hi ua, kipahna dan leng thei un.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

paite: Khrist thu a hauhna teng toh noumau ah dimsak kiihkeih un, pilna chiteng a kisinsak leh kihilhtuah a om in, kipahna lungtang toh Pathian kiang a phatna late, Pathian late, khalam late sa in om un.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

paite: Huan na hih peuhmah uh thugen ah leh thilhih ah amah ziak a Pa Pathian kiang a kipahthu gen kawm in Toupa Jesu min in hih vek un.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

paite: Zite aw, Toupa ah akilawm hun bang zel in na pasalte uh kiang ah kiniamkhiak un.
heading: Khristian Inkuan Omdan Zite Leh Pasalte
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

paite: Pasalte aw, na zite uh it unla, alak uah hanhat kei un.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

paite: Naupangte aw, bangkim ah na nu uleh na pate uh thu mang un, huai tuh Toupa pahtak lam ahi.
heading: Nu Leh Pate Leh Tate
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

paite: Pate aw, na tate uh hihnuak kei un, huchi lou in zaw alunglel kha ding uhi.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

paite: Sikhate aw, sa a na heutute uh thu bangkim ah mang un, mihing hihkipak lelte bang a mitmei nasem hilou in, lungtang sa khat a Toupa kihta kawm in,
heading: Sikhate Leh Pute
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

paite: na hih peuhmah uh, mihing a ding bang a hih lou in, Toupa a ding zaw in kilawptak in hih un;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

paite: Toupa a kipan in a-itna gouluah ding na mu ding uh chih thei in, Toupa Khrist nasem na hi uhi.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

paite: Thil diklou hihpa'n athil diklou hihman amu nawn ding hi; mi khentuamna a-om ngal kei hi.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.
